theorems.name: Submission.doraggt_ae_weighted_graph_blowup_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (ι : Euclid n →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (ι' : Euclid k →ₗᵢ[ℝ] Euclid (n + k)) (f : Euclid n → Euclid k) (L : NNReal) (G : Euclid n → ℝ) (C : ℝ), (∀ v w, inner ℝ (ι v) (ι' w) = 0) → LipschitzWith L f → Measurable G → (∀ u, |G u| ≤ C) → ∀ᵐ v ∂(volume : Measure (Euclid n)), DifferentiableAt ℝ f v ∧ ∀ ψ : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ, Continuous ψ → HasCompactSupport ψ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => ∫ w, ψ (ι w + ι' (r⁻¹ • (f (v + r • w) - f v))) * G (v + r • w)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (G v * ∫ w, ψ (ι w + ι' (fderiv ℝ f v w))))
